decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a low-cost variant of existing drainage products that taps an ongoing design trend, and its prospects after one year are still uncertain, so keeping the option open costs little.
The shower channel has its own page and fits the growing demand for seamless, barrier-free bathrooms, so it is a promising option worth keeping while results come in.
The pump-assisted solution is more complex and serves a niche, and it is only mentioned on the website, but one year is too early to judge its value, so management keeps it under observation.
The tileable floor drain has its own page and sits close to the firm's core competence, so it is cheap to maintain and its upside is still unresolved.
The stainless steel design grate builds on the firm's metalworking strengths, has its own page and costs little to keep, so the option stays open.
